decision.reason: [ev-3cb4e124106a] is a one-line changelog entry. It says only that profiling integrations were added to tracing instrumentation, and otherwise just points to PR 11633. It doesn't name a concrete subject such as a config key, flag or component. It also doesn't say whether the feature is on by default or opt-in, which configurations are exposed, or what happens to an operator who does nothing. The PR description or the matching config and docs changes are needed before the typed assertion can be written.
